maria_cs: FYI: healthscore drift alert triggered for onboarding cohort B - several accounts moved from green -> yellow overnight. also saw playbook send rate spike coincident with the drift. tagging data + infra to check correlations. @ryan_data @sam_backend
ryan_data: looking. preliminary check shows feature `days_active` was null for a subset after a recent contact import; healthscore model treats nulls as 0 which pulled scores down. import used a new CSV pipeline that didn't map `last_active`.
sam_backend: ok. two action items: 1) add defensive mapping in the import to map missing `last_active` -> `created_at`, 2) throttle playbook send rate when >X% of cohort changed state in last 2h to avoid noisy emails. i'll add a soft throttle in the runner behind FF `playbook_send_throttle`.
jordan_ops: propose throttle rule: if cohort_bad_delta_rate > 0.05 then cap sends to 10% of candidates per hour and queue rest for manual review. metric name `cohort_state_change_rate`.
olivia_csm: please ensure enterprise/pilot accounts are excluded from throttling and get manual review instead. i'll prep a list of accounts that must always be manual. also need a short note for CS leads explaining the drift and mitigation plan.
ryan_data: i'll backfill corrected `last_active` for the last 30 days and rerun scores. small query: `update contacts set last_active = created_at where last_active is null and source = 'import_csv'` will fix it. will run dry-run and post counts.
maria_cs: timeline? which owner for rollback if throttle causes missed sends?
sam_backend: i'll own the throttle FF rollout. deploy tomorrow 09:00 UTC with FF off by default, enable for 5% then monitor `missed_nudges` and `duplicate_sends`. rollback via FF or kill switch endpoint.
olj: (typo)
jordan_ops: added runbook note: if more than 100 enterprise accounts queued, escalate to @olivia_csm for manual triage.
olivia_csm: got it. i'll draft the CS note and coordinate manual reviews. please post the dry-run counts and the FF rollout plan in this thread. :thumbsup:
